summary_1line: Yudhishthira, Krishna, and Arjuna send fierce replies through Uluka, condemning Duryodhana and declaring that battle will begin with Bhishma’s fall.

image_candidates.scene_text: Yudhishthira, eyes red with anger and arms raised, speaks fiercely while kings watch in tense silence.
Krishna beside Arjuna warns that his wrath could burn assembled kings like fire consuming straw.
Arjuna vows before the gathered warriors that he will strike down Bhishma with a storm of arrows at sunrise.
